title: Declare KMS rotation playbook and RBAC provenance ledger
author: Maya Kapoor
release_notes: Adds a documented KMS rotation playbook for operators and a lightweight RBAC provenance ledger to record policy mutations for audit; no behavioral change to runtime authorization by default (opt-in).
description: Motivation: This PR codifies two complementary compliance primitives requested in ENG-2244 and SEC-312: 1) an operator playbook and a small control-plane workflow to rotate customer-facing KMS keys (CMKs) without losing audit traceability; and 2) a compact RBAC provenance ledger that records policy diffs and the operator identity that applied them. Goals: make rotations auditable and reversible while minimizing blast radius and operational friction. Summary of changes: docs/playbooks/kms-rotation.md contains a step-by-step playbook with prechecks, staged rotation, rollback criteria, and CLI snippets for operators; control-plane/kms/rotation-controller.go implements an idempotent coordinator that sequences key rollover, writes replay-safe audit annotations, and temporarily aliases keys to avoid token churn; control-plane/rbac/provenance/ledger.go implements an append-only ledger format using gzipped JSON entries with SHA256 checksums and signatures; migrations/20251112_add_rbac_ledger_table.sql adds a small relational index for quick lookups; infra/helm/templates/rotation-job.yaml provides scheduled rotation and verification job templates; tests/integration/rotation_rbac_endtoend.test exercises rollover while requests are in-flight; sdk/python/examples/rotate_kms_key.py shows a sample tenant script; observability adds metrics kms_rotation_start, kms_rotation_success, kms_rotation_failure and an audit annotation audit.kms_rotation_note. Commit summary: Maya K: introduce kms rotation playbook and controller scaffolding; Maya K: implement provenance ledger encoding and table migration; Maya K: add helm job and CI integration tests; Fix: handle alias propagation race with KV cache warmers; Docs: polish playbook and add runbook checklist. Review conversation excerpt: Evan Brooks: Nice separation of concerns; a few comments on failure modes for alias propagation. Please add an idempotency test for the controller. Maya Kapoor: Added idempotency test and expanded alias propagation handling; see followup commit — thanks. Sana Iqbal: We need a clear CI gating step to ensure rotation metrics are emitted to the compliance pipeline before marking rotation complete. Can we add a verification job? Maya Kapoor: Added infra/helm verification job and CI integration test that validates metrics emission to the audit sink. Diego Marquez: Question about ledger size growth — are we capping retention? Also want to ensure ledger entries are signed. Maya Kapoor: Ledger entries are gzipped JSON with SHA256 checksums and signed by the control-plane signing key; retention policy is tenant-configurable (default 7y). Added schema to docs. Sana Iqbal: Approved after test and verification job updates. Evan Brooks: Approved. Merge-bot: PR squash-merged. CI history: initial CI run failed due to lint error in rotation-controller.go import ordering; subsequent run fixed and all checks green. Risk and rollout notes: Low-risk additive change. The provenance ledger is opt-in via a feature flag; the rotation controller is gated behind helm values rotation.enabled and supports rotation.dry_run for safe validation. Default behavior unchanged. Operational considerations: the playbook includes pre/post audit assertions, a checklist for legal/compliance, and an incident-playbook snippet for accidental key exposure. Ledger storage: entries stored both as HMAC-signed blobs in object storage and indexed metadata in the relational table; ledger blobs are immutable and include linked Linear ticket ID when present. Testing notes: unit tests for ledger encoding and signature verification added; an integration test simulates key rollover during in-flight requests and asserts no auth failures and correct ledger creation. Docs and runbook: docs/playbooks/kms-rotation.md describes operator steps, required permissions, rollback criteria, and sample artifact attachments for compliance review; rbac provenance spec documents delta format, checksum/signature scheme, and the reconciliation CLI control-plane/rbac/provenance/reconcile. Post-merge actions: enable feature in staging for two weeks and run a sample tenant rotation; security to review signing key handling and consider rotating the control-plane signing key; docs team to link playbook from compliance portal. Related Linear/Jira: ENG-2244, SEC-312. Merge: squash-merged into main on 2025-11-20.
notes: Provenance ledger is additive and opt-in; helm chart exposes rotation.enabled and rotation.dry_run; retention and signing key rotation delegated to tenant/operator configuration.
